questions.question: Choose the option that is in the direct form of the sentence. The tribunal said that there had been an alarming increase in the pollution in Delhi from all sorts of vehicles.

options.a: The tribunal says, "There were an alarming increase in the pollution in Delhi from all sorts of vehicles".
options.b: The tribunal said, "There has been an alarming increase in the pollution in Delhi from all sorts of vehicles".
options.c: The tribunal reports, "That there has been an alarming increase in the pollution in Delhi from all sorts of vehicles".
options.d: The tribunal said, "There have been an alarming increase in the pollution in Delhi from all sorts of vehicles".

questions.solution: In direct speech, 'had been' in the indirect speech indicates that the tense in the direct speech was 'has been' (Present Perfect). Therefore, option (b) is the correct direct form.

questions.question: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech. Elisa ordered her brother to play outside and let her work in peace.

options.a: Elisa said to her brother, “Play outside that let me do my work in peace.”
options.b: Elisa said to her brother, “Play outside and let me work in peace.”
options.c: Elisa said to her brother, “Play outside to let me do my work in peace.”
options.d: Elisa said to her brother, “Play outside and let me do my work in peace.”

questions.solution: The correct answer is "Elisa said to her brother, “play outside and let me work in peace.”"

questions.question: Direction: Change the sentence from direct speech to indirect speech. Tarun says to the manager, "Representatives of the member states will be meeting next week."

options.a: Tarun tells the manager that representatives of the member states will be meeting next week.
options.b: Tarun tells the manager that representatives of the member states would be meeting next week.
options.c: Tarun tells the manager that representatives of the member states are going to meet next week.
options.d: Tarun tells the manager that representatives of the member states meet next week.

questions.solution: Since the reporting verb 'says' is in the present tense, the tense of the reported speech does not change when converting to indirect speech.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’. The IIT Bombay alumnus occupy leading positions in different areas of profession and service.
questions.solution: The subject 'IIT Bombay' refers to an institution, and the plural of 'alumnus' is 'alumni', which is required here to agree with the plural verb 'occupy'.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to substitute the bracket segment in the given sentence. If no substitution is required, select No substitution required. Giraffe deaths have also increased because human populations (has grow and expand into) what used to be wild lands.
questions.solution: The subject 'human populations' is plural, so it requires the plural verb 'have'. Also, the verb should be in the past participle form 'grown' and 'expanded' to maintain parallel structure and correct tense.

questions.question: Fill in the blank with correct option. A good homework space is well-lit, with paper and pencils. ________, it is quiet and distraction free.
questions.solution: The sentence adds more positive characteristics to the homework space, therefore 'In addition' is the correct connector.

questions.question:
Read each sentence to find out whether there is any grammatical error in it. The error, if any will be in one part of the sentence. The letter of that part is the answer. If there is no error, the answer is (D). (Ignore the errors of punctuation, if any).

I could not convince them (A) /because they persisted to suggest (B) / that I was lying. (C) / No error. (D)
questions.solution: The error is in part (B). The verb 'persist' is followed by the preposition 'in' and a gerund (-ing form). Therefore, 'persisted to suggest' should be replaced with 'persisted in suggesting'.
